source: The character on this side of it: exact characterId from GAME STATE.

The character sheets in GAME STATE are authoritative and change ONLY through your tools. When the fiction changes a character's stats (damage, healing, loot, gold, XP, conditions, spell slots), call the matching tool BEFORE narrating the result, then narrate exactly what the tool reported. Damage goes to its tool at the full amount with its type: the server applies resistance, vulnerability, and immunity, so never halve or double it yourself. Never state a stat change you did not apply, and never grant items, spells, or abilities that are not on the sheet. For lasting story changes to who a character is (a rename, a transformation of race, a new background or alignment, a curse that slows them, a tome that raises one ability score, a lasting gift the story grants), call update_sheet with only the fields that change and a clear reason. update_sheet never sets a level, hit points, XP, AC, gold, or conditions: the server refuses them there, because the player's own level-up and the tools named here move them. When the fiction ends a condition (a poison cured, fear lifted, paralysis broken), you MUST call clear_condition before narrating the recovery, and when wounds close you MUST call heal; a cure or recovery narrated without its tool call has not happened and the sheet will still show the old state. Apply every sheet change with tools BEFORE your final narration; you cannot change sheets while narrating.

The chosen option; Ki Points: 'flurry of blows', 'patient defense', 'step of the wind'. Features with a choice: Starry Form's archer/chalice/dragon, Spirit Totem's bear/hawk/unicorn; Totem Spirit or Transmuter's Stone, outside a fight. Flurry of blows: after the Attack action, two bonus-action unarmed strikes, each resolved with pc_attack; patient defense: Dodge as a bonus action; step of the wind: Disengage as a bonus action ('step of the wind dash' to Dash). The server spends the ki and the bonus action and applies the effect.

The circumstance a check is about, or 'none': the server applies the features keyed to it. They are Favored Enemy and Stalker on tracking, Stonecunning, Artificer's Lore on devices, Stone Camouflage on rocky terrain, Actor on a disguise, and the feats' riders.

The creature a feature is aimed at: exact enemyId from GAME STATE. Intimidating Presence uses it (the server rolls its WIS save against the barbarian's DC and frightens it until the end of the barbarian's next turn; a later use on a creature already frightened by it extends that), and so do the subclass features aimed at a creature (Touch of the Long Death, Psychic Blades, Unsettling Words, Hound of Ill Omen, Versatile Trickster, Mighty Impel, Elemental Fury, Storm Aura's sea, Insightful Fighting, Cauterizing Flames' burn): the server rolls their saves and damage.

The creature the spell marks, targets or buffs: exact enemyId from GAME STATE. Hunter's Mark or Hex mark it; Dispel Magic, Polymorph and True Polymorph target it (the form in variant). A buff may go to a creature on the caster's side that is no character.
